content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for GBPUAT Assistant Professor posts differs by college. The essential qualifications prescribed in the notification are summarized below. A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade on a point scale) in a concerned, relevant, or allied subject from an Indian university, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. The candidate must also have cleared NET conducted by UGC, ICAR, or CSIR, or an equivalent test accredited by UGC such as SLET/SET - OR hold a Ph.D. awarded as per UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 (with certain conditions for candidates registered before 11 July 2009). Alternatively, a Ph.D. from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 globally by QS, THE, or ARWU (Shanghai) also satisfies the qualification. A basic B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree from a college recognized by the Veterinary Council of India, and registration with the State/Central Veterinary Council. In addition, the Master's degree (55% marks) plus NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D.-based exemption criteria described above, OR a Ph.D. from a top-500-ranked foreign university/institution. As per AICTE Regulation 2019: B.E. / B.Tech. / B.S. and M.E. / M.Tech. / M.S. (or Integrated M.Tech.) in the relevant branch, with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees. As per AICTE Regulation 2019: a Bachelor's degree in any discipline and a Master's Degree in Business Administration / PGDM / C.A. / ICWA / M.Com. with first class or equivalent, along with two years of professional experience after acquiring the Master's degree. A 5% relaxation is allowed at both Bachelor's and Master's level for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer) and differently-abled candidates for the purpose of eligibility and assessing academic record. A 5% relaxation (from 55% to 50%) is provided to Ph.D. degree holders who obtained their Master's degree prior to 19 September 1991. The exact list of concerned/allied/relevant subjects for each department is given in Annexure-III of the official notification; the decision of the screening committee on relevance of a discipline is final.

faq.question: Q1. What is GBPUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Employment Notice No. A-31/2026 issued by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar, for direct recruitment to 63 Assistant Professor (Academic Level-10) posts across 40 disciplines in seven colleges.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GBPUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 63 vacancies in total, distributed as SC-13, ST-2, OBC-10, EWS-4, and UR-34 across the different disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GBPUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the University to receive the completed application is 16 October 2026, till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for GBPUAT Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by college: generally a Master's degree with 55% marks plus NET/SLET/SET or a qualifying Ph.D. for Agriculture, Community Science, Basic Sciences & Humanities and Fisheries colleges; a B.V.Sc. & A.H. degree plus the Master's/NET or Ph.D. criteria for Veterinary Sciences; a relevant B.E./B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech. for Technology; and a Bachelor's plus MBA/PGDM/CA/ICWA/M.Com with two years' experience for Agribusiness Management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for GBPUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1500/- for UR and OBC candidates, Rs. 1000/- for EWS candidates, and Rs. 750/- for SC and ST candidates, payable by Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for GBPUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application is offline only. Candidates must download the prescribed format from www.gbpuat.ac.in, fill it, attach the required documents and fee, and send it by Speed Post or Registered Post to the Chief Personnel Officer Office at GBPUAT, Pantnagar, before the last date. E-mail, fax, and other electronic submissions are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GBPUAT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a screening step based on an Academic/Research Score (maximum 100 marks, covering Graduation, Post-Graduation, Ph.D./M.Phil., NET/SLET-SET, publications, teaching/post-doctoral experience, and awards), followed by an interview (maximum 20 marks). Final selection is based on interview performance.
